description: GTFS – Réseau de transport TMCO (3CO, Mayotte) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes du Centre-Ouest. This dataset contains information in GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) format of the TMCO (Transport and Mobility of the Centre-Ouest) public transport network, operated on the territory of the Community of Communes of the Centre-Ouest (3CO) in Mayotte. Coverage: Communauté de Communes du Centre-Ouest. The portal shows the English title as "GTFS – TMCO Transport Network (3CO, Mayotte)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes du Centre-Ouest. Its keywords include tmco, mayotte, open-data-france, horaires, 3co, arrets. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
